lyrics:
[Intro: dark choir aahs, staccato strings, slow heavy drums]

[Verse 1: male rap, low and steady]
I clock in before the sun can find my street
Count my blessings, then I count what's on the sheet
Mama said the meek inherit, I ain't seen the will
Forty-something summers and I'm paying on it still
I was raised to keep my head down, keep my hands fast
Stack a little, lose a little, make the last last
Got a ladder made of paper leaning on a cloud
Every rung another reason not to say it loud
I look in the mirror, see my father's tired eyes
Same uniform, different logo, same size
They sold us on a finish line that moves when we run
Tell me, when's the part where somebody says we won?

[Chorus: soul tenor sings, full choir answers]
Been so long in the kingdom of the grind
Can't tell the sunrise from the sign
Keep on running, running out of time
In the kingdom of the grind
Who's gonna tell the children why
We traded all the daylight for the dime?
Been so long, been so long
In the kingdom of the grind

[Verse 2: male rap, more urgent]
Notifications like a choir in my pocket
Every buzz another promise, every promise got a docket
I got friends I only see inside a square
Sending prayers with a thumb like a thumb is a prayer
My boy is at the table and he's looking at my screen
Learning what a man is from the gaps in between
I said I'd make the game, I said I'd make the play
But the meeting ran long, like it does every day
Rent is due on Friday, hope is due on Sunday
Body's due for resting but it's booked until Monday
I keep telling myself that it's only for a season
Twenty seasons later, still looking for the reason

[Chorus: soul tenor sings, full choir answers]
Been so long in the kingdom of the grind
Can't tell the sunrise from the sign
Keep on running, running out of time
In the kingdom of the grind
Who's gonna tell the children why
We traded all the daylight for the dime?
Been so long, been so long
In the kingdom of the grind

[Verse 3: drums drop out, rap over choir and strings]
Tell me why we're so quick to price a soul
Got the whole world in a cart and still a hole
If I laid it all down, would the ground still hold?
Would my name still echo if it wasn't in gold?
Maybe heaven was a porch step and a ball
Before I learned to measure, before I learned to fall
So I'm clocking out early, gonna walk my son home
Let the kingdom keep the crown, I'm taking back my own

[Final Chorus: drums return, choir at full voice, ad-libs]
Been so long in the kingdom of the grind
Can't tell the sunrise from the sign
Keep on running, running out of time
In the kingdom of the grind

[Outro: choir hums, strings fade, one last bass note]
Been so long
Been so long
